items.text:
welp i like this game, and their is updates so often but im getting hit by i would count pretty big bugs like getting cut off from the commercial (this bug i think there a thread as old 2021) so some gigs cant get to and buying ships, another for some reason couldnt place a battery charger

welp guess ill start another charter and spend like 10m making one, then another 20 running around making least 5k, 3rd time the charm sigh....hopefully i can get further this time
items.text_zh:
唉，我喜欢这款游戏，而且更新很频繁，但我被一些我认为相当大的bug击中了，比如被切断与商业的联系（这个bug我想有个2021年的老帖子），所以有些任务接不了，还有买船，另一个不知为何无法放置电池充电器

唉，看来我得再开一个包机，花个1000万造一艘，然后再花2000万到处跑，至少赚5000，第三次总该成功了吧，叹气……希望这次我能走得更远
